_note: Explicitly reviewed identities for Batch 26. Each entry names one OSM object per entity. Reviewed entries bypass the name-label and kind gates of the Batch 20b matcher (identity was checked by hand) but must still pass: versioned source, valid geometry, bbox, lifecycle policy. Sector distance is recorded; it is not a gate for these entries (see README).

new_archive.format: JSON object with lookup (verbatim Nominatim jsonv2 items including geojson) and meta (OSM API version, timestamp, changeset, tags keyed like way24886453)
